lines.text: The LORD tells Moses to speak to the Israelites about vows, and a male from twenty to sixty is valued at fifty shekels of silver.
A vower too poor to pay goes before the priest, and a swapped offering animal and its substitute both become holy.
To redeem a vowed unclean animal or a consecrated house, the owner must add a third to the value.
A bought field consecrated to the LORD returns at the Year of Jubilee to the priests, and no one may consecrate a firstborn animal.
The tithe from the land belongs to the LORD, and every tenth animal passing under the shepherd's rod is holy.
